stora-tee-06-1.reason: Years disagree: on 2021 the ring encloses a pale bare pad (sand- or soil-coloured, no turf) while on 2025 it encloses an evenly mown deck that the line follows, so the deck was built or resurfaced between the two photos.
stora-tee-06-1.resolution: the deck was resurfaced between April 2021 and June 2025 (a bare pad then, mown now); the ring follows the 2025 deck, and it is level in the laser terrain (deck-ground.mjs), so the terrain already holds it

stora-tee-07-2.reason: A dark tree crown fills the west half of the ring in the same place on both photos, and open mown turf with tee markers shows only in the east half, so the line takes in a tree or a deck that cannot be seen under it.
stora-tee-07-2.resolution: the laser's level deck (31.3 m over E 639545-639553, N 6635711-6635720, deck-ground.mjs --around) lies under the ring: the conifer's crown overhangs the deck's west half on both photos, and the deck goes on under it

stora-green-08.reason: Years disagree: on 2021 the green is ringed by bare tan ground and the bunker at its west edge shows no white sand, while on 2025 the surrounds are grassed; the line follows the putting surface on both, but the green complex was rebuilt between them.
stora-green-08.fault: the 8th was reworked after April 2021: its green stood in bare ground then, and its large left bunker (stora-bunker-08-1) was turf. The ring follows the 2025 putting surface; the terrain under the hole may be older than the work (the bunker has no bowl in it). Put right by a newer laser flight over the 8th, or by reshaping the terrain there in a new ground generation

stora-bunker-08-1.reason: Years disagree: on 2025 the line follows clean sand, but on 2021 the same place is pale disturbed ground with no sand inside the line, so the bunker was built between the two photos.
stora-bunker-08-1.fault: built after April 2021 (96% turf on that photo) and 0.08 m under the ground round it: the terrain was flown before it and has no bowl for it, so it is drawn as nearly flat sand. Put right by a newer laser flight, or by carving its bowl in a new ground generation

stora-bunker-15-2.reason: Years disagree: on 2021 a dark strip about a metre or more wide lies inside the ring's straight west side, on the side away from where the lip shadows fall on the other bunkers, where on 2025 sand reaches the line; at this scale I cannot tell whether the sand was widened since or the line overreaches.
stora-bunker-15-2.resolution: widened on its west side after April 2021 (the sand audit reads 83% sand then); the ring follows the 2025 sand, which is the newer outline
